properties.title: Delayed Bluetooth reconnection after ignition
properties.description: Bluetooth reconnection sometimes exceeds the 10-second requirement because the connection request remains queued longer than expected.

properties.title: Missing reconnection completion diagnostic event
properties.description: The diagnostic service does not always record the completion event for a successful reconnection attempt.

properties.title: Media audio profile not restored
properties.description: The phone reconnects successfully but the media audio profile is not restored in some vehicle executions.

properties.name: Bluetooth Phone Automatic Reconnection
properties.description: Automatically reconnect a previously paired Bluetooth phone after a vehicle ignition cycle.

properties.title: Automatic reconnection after ignition
properties.description: The system shall automatically reconnect a previously paired phone after the vehicle ignition is switched on.

properties.title: Reconnection within ten seconds
properties.description: The system shall complete Bluetooth phone reconnection within 10 seconds after the Bluetooth subsystem becomes available.

properties.title: Reuse stored pairing information
properties.description: The system shall use stored pairing information to reconnect the phone without requiring the user to repeat the pairing process.

properties.title: Transient reconnection retry
properties.description: The system shall retry the Bluetooth connection once when the first reconnection attempt fails because of a transient communication error.

properties.title: Restore supported Bluetooth profiles
properties.description: After reconnection, the system shall restore the supported phone and media audio profiles.

properties.title: Record reconnection diagnostics
properties.description: The system shall record diagnostic events for the start, completion, failure, and duration of each reconnection attempt.

properties.title: Handle Bluetooth-disabled phones
properties.description: The system shall stop automatic reconnection attempts when Bluetooth is disabled on the paired phone.

properties.name: Vehicle State Adapter
properties.description: Receives vehicle ignition and power-state events and makes them available to the connectivity software.

properties.name: Bluetooth Connection Manager
properties.description: Controls automatic Bluetooth reconnection attempts, retry behavior, connection timing, and cancellation.

properties.name: Pairing Data Store
properties.description: Stores and retrieves pairing credentials and metadata for previously paired Bluetooth devices.

properties.name: Bluetooth Profile Service
properties.description: Restores supported Bluetooth profiles such as phone audio and media audio after a connection is established.

properties.name: Connectivity Diagnostics Service
properties.description: Records diagnostic events and timing information for Bluetooth connection attempts.

properties.title: Automatic reconnection after ignition
properties.description: Verify that a previously paired phone reconnects automatically after an ignition cycle.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired; Bluetooth is enabled; ignition is off.
properties.expectedResult: The phone reconnects automatically without user interaction.

properties.title: Reconnection time verification
properties.description: Measure the time required to reconnect a previously paired phone after ignition.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired and available; ignition is off.

properties.title: Stored pairing reuse
properties.description: Verify that stored pairing data is reused after an ignition cycle.
properties.preconditions: Phone was paired before shutdown; pairing data is stored.
properties.expectedResult: The phone reconnects without requesting a new pairing confirmation.

properties.title: Transient failure retry
properties.description: Verify that the system retries after one simulated transient connection failure.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired; the first connection attempt is configured to fail temporarily.
properties.expectedResult: The system performs one retry and reconnects successfully.

properties.title: Bluetooth profile restoration
properties.description: Verify restoration of phone audio and media audio profiles after reconnection.
properties.preconditions: Phone supports phone audio and media audio profiles.
properties.expectedResult: Both supported profiles become available after reconnection.

properties.title: Reconnection diagnostic logging
properties.description: Verify that diagnostic events are recorded during a reconnection attempt.
properties.preconditions: Diagnostic logging is enabled; phone is paired.
properties.expectedResult: Start, completion, result, and duration events are recorded.

properties.title: Repeated ignition cycle reconnection
properties.description: Verify reconnection behavior over five consecutive ignition cycles.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired; five ignition cycles can be performed.
properties.expectedResult: The phone reconnects automatically within 10 seconds during every cycle.

properties.title: Weak-signal reconnection retry
properties.description: Verify reconnection and retry behavior when the phone signal is temporarily weak.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired and placed near the edge of Bluetooth range.
properties.expectedResult: The system retries if needed and reconnects within 10 seconds.

properties.title: Delayed phone availability
properties.description: Verify reconnection when the phone becomes available several seconds after ignition.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired; phone Bluetooth becomes available three seconds after ignition.
properties.expectedResult: The system detects the phone and reconnects automatically.

properties.title: Cold-start reconnection performance
properties.description: Measure reconnection time after a complete infotainment system shutdown.
properties.preconditions: Phone is paired; infotainment system is fully powered down.
properties.expectedResult: The phone reconnects within 10 seconds after Bluetooth becomes available.

cases.question: Which source systems contribute facts to the investigation of EXEC-010?

graph.cypher:
MATCH (te:TestExecution {id: "EXEC-010"})
OPTIONAL MATCH (te)-[:EXECUTION_OF]->(t:Test)
OPTIONAL MATCH (te)-[:PRODUCES]->(tt:TestTrace)
OPTIONAL MATCH (te)-[:HAS_DEFECT_TICKET]->(dt:DefectTicket)
OPTIONAL MATCH (dt)-[:AFFECTS]->(sc:SoftwareComponent)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:VERIFIES]->(req:Requirement)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f:Feature)-[:HAS_REQUIREMENT]->(req)
WITH [te, t, tt, dt, sc, req, f] AS nodes
UNWIND nodes AS node
WITH node.sourceSystem AS sourceSystem
WHERE sourceSystem IS NOT NULL
RETURN DISTINCT sourceSystem
ORDER BY sourceSystem

cases.question: Which defect ticket is linked to failed executions in more than one test environment, and which environments are involved?

response.question: What is a Knowledge Graph?
response.answer:
A **Knowledge Graph** is a structured representation of information that connects entities and relationships in a network format. It organizes data as interconnected nodes (entities) and edges (relationships), making it possible to:

- **Store complex relationships** between entities (e.g., requirements link to tests, tests link to defects)
- **Query and discover patterns** across the data
- **Enable semantic reasoning** — understanding meaning beyond just keywords
- **Support rich navigation** — exploring connections between related entities

In the context of this Bluetooth Reconnection project, the Knowledge Graph captures engineering entities like Requirements, SoftwareComponents, Tests, TestExecutions, Defects, and their relationships, enabling you to trace how features connect to tests, how tests connect to issues, and so forth. This provides visibility into the engineering workflow and dependencies.
